displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 21 is 2 short and 1 long
meaning: Gas heating lockout. The control will not auto-reset. The chart says to check for a mis-wired gas valve or a defective control valve relay.
diySteps: Count 2 short flashes and 1 long flash. This lockout does not clear itself after 3 hours
If you smell gas, leave the building and call the gas supplier from outside
Technician: check the gas-valve wiring and the valve relay on the control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not jumper the gas valve to get heat back.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
